sentences.en: And what I mean by that is when we first started this rewatch, so many people would come up to us and tell us how many times they had watched the show all the way through.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当我们刚开始重温这部剧时，很多人走过来告诉我们他们把这部剧完整地看了多少遍。

sentences.en: And it's many times.
I mean, you guys have really watched the show.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你们是真的把这部剧看进去了。

sentences.en: And I realized there were so many episodes, I mean whole seasons, that I hadn't seen since they aired.
sentences.zh: 我意识到有太多集，我是说整整几季，自从播出后我就没再看过。

sentences.en: Yeah.
So I have this new appreciation for the fandom because, like what you were just saying, we're coming to the end of this rewatch,
sentences.zh: 所以我对粉丝群体有了新的欣赏，因为就像你刚才说的，我们快要重温完了，

sentences.en: and I find myself just so desperately wanting to go back to season one.
sentences.zh: 我发现自己非常渴望回到第一季。

sentences.en: Me too.
It's emotional, and it's comforting to go back to those seasons.
sentences.zh: 回到那些季节让人感慨，也让人感到慰藉。

sentences.en: And, you know, I was thinking about which episodes were my favorite, and I know I have my go-tos that I've always liked, like dinner party, things like that.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我在想哪些集是我最喜欢的，我知道我有一直以来都喜欢的必看集，比如《晚宴》之类的。

sentences.en: Sure, sure.
But in my rewatch, kind of like you with Mafia, a few that snuck up on me that I'd just forgotten about was, like, the deposition, for example.
sentences.zh: 但在重温过程中，就像你对《黑手党》那一集的感觉一样，有几集让我感到意外，我都快忘了，比如《取证》那一集。

sentences.en: Love it.
Every moment in that deposition when Michael's being cross-examined is just hilarious.
sentences.zh: 在《取证》里，迈克尔被盘问的每一个瞬间都太搞笑了。

sentences.en: I forgot about sconesy cider.
sentences.zh: 我都忘了斯康西·赛德了。

sentences.en: Oh, I forget the christening, you know?
sentences.zh: 噢，我忘了《洗礼》那一集了，你知道吗？

sentences.en: But I do.
I find myself wanting to go back.
sentences.zh: 我发现自己想回去重温。

sentences.en: I want to see the first party planning committee meeting.
sentences.zh: 我想看第一次派对策划委员会会议。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
I want to go back to all of that.
sentences.zh: 我想回到这一切的起点。

sentences.en: Well, when we talked to Billie Eilish on the podcast, we asked her about rewatching, and I kind of think of her as a rewatch expert because she really has seen it so many times.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当我们在播客中与比莉·艾利什交谈时，我们问了她关于重温的问题，我觉得她算得上是重温专家，因为她确实看了太多遍了。

sentences.en: And we asked her, do you ever skip anything?
sentences.zh: 我们问她，你会跳过什么吗？

sentences.en: You know, do you have favorite seasons?
sentences.zh: 你知道，你有最喜欢的季节吗？

sentences.en: Will you just start with a certain thing?
sentences.zh: 你会直接从某处开始看吗？

sentences.en: And she said no.
She said she always goes back to the very beginning, and she watches everything, although she did say sometimes she skips Scott's Tots.
sentences.zh: 她说她总是从头开始，把所有内容都看一遍，不过她确实说过有时会跳过《斯科特的托特们》那一集。

sentences.en: Well, you know.
That's the only one.
That's okay.
One about the family paper company.
sentences.zh: 就是关于那家家族造纸公司的。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
That they closed down.
They put out a business.
sentences.zh: 他们让那家公司倒闭了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
Yeah.
Prince family paper.
Prince family paper.
That one, I couldn't take it.
sentences.zh: 那一集，我实在看不下去。

sentences.en: Oh.
But, Allison, fantastic question.
sentences.zh: 不过，艾莉森，这个问题问得太棒了。

sentences.en: It clearly made Jenna and I think a lot about this rewatch and what it's meant to us, and we both want to start back at the beginning.
sentences.zh: 这显然让珍娜和我对这次重温产生了许多思考，也让我们意识到它对我们的意义，我们俩都想从头开始再看一遍。

sentences.en: We do.
But don't worry, we will cover season nine.
sentences.zh: 但别担心，我们还是会讲到第九季的。

sentences.en: Yes.
Yes.
Not to get ahead of ourselves.
All right.
Fast fact number three is a fan question from Curtis G.
sentences.zh: 第三个冷知识来自粉丝柯蒂斯·G的提问。

sentences.en: in Seattle.
I didn't think there was anything else that we could learn, Angela, about, I don't know, the origins of characters or anything this long into our rewatch.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，我本以为重温到这个阶段，关于角色起源之类的东西，我们已经没什么可学的了。

sentences.en: But Curtis has found something that I didn't know.
sentences.zh: 但柯蒂斯发现了一些我不知道的事情。

sentences.en: What?
Here's what Curtis said.
When I was in grad school, one of my professors was named Andy Bernard.
sentences.zh: 我在读研时，有一位教授叫安迪·伯纳德。

sentences.en: There was a rumor that he and Greg Daniels were friends in college and that Greg named Ed's character after him.
sentences.zh: 有传言说他和格雷格·丹尼尔斯是大学好友，格雷格是用他的名字给艾德的角色命名的。

sentences.en: Is it true that Andy Bernard on the office is named after Professor Andy Bernard at Dartmouth?
sentences.zh: 《办公室》里的安迪·伯纳德真的是以达特茅斯学院的安迪·伯纳德教授命名的吗？

sentences.en: I would not be surprised at all because Greg liked to do that.
sentences.zh: 我一点也不惊讶，因为格雷格就喜欢这么做。

sentences.en: Well, I asked Greg.
What'd he say?
He said, you can tell Curtis G.
sentences.zh: 他说，你可以告诉柯蒂斯·G。

sentences.en: that it is completely true that Andy Bernard on the office is named after Professor Andy Bernard at Dartmouth.
sentences.zh: 《办公室》里的安迪·伯纳德确实是以达特茅斯学院的安迪·伯纳德教授命名的，这完全属实。

sentences.en: However, Andy and I and our mutual friend Jim Halpert have been great friends since first grade.
sentences.zh: 不过，安迪和我以及我们的共同好友吉姆·哈珀特从一年级起就是好朋友了。

sentences.en: So, Greg's two childhood friends are named Jim Halpert and Andy Bernard.
sentences.zh: 所以，格雷格的两个童年好友分别叫吉姆·哈珀特和安迪·伯纳德。

sentences.en: Yeah.
I knew Jim Halpert.
sentences.zh: 我知道吉姆·哈珀特的事。

sentences.en: Same.
But, oh my gosh.
Greg said that it was really fun for him to give the characters his old friends' names.
sentences.zh: 格雷格说，用老朋友的名字来命名角色让他觉得非常有趣。

sentences.en: He never thought that people would still be asking about it 20 years later.
sentences.zh: 他从没想过20年后还会有人问起这件事。

sentences.en: Greg also said the real life Andy Bernard is at Dartmouth, which is Cornell's big rival,
sentences.zh: 格雷格还说，现实生活中的安迪·伯纳德在达特茅斯学院，那是康奈尔大学的死对头，

sentences.en: and that the real Andy Bernard is not much like the character of Andy Bernard.
sentences.zh: 而且现实中的安迪·伯纳德和剧中的安迪·伯纳德一点也不像。

sentences.en: Well, I should think not.
He did say he thinks the real Andy Bernard might have had one of those preppy belts with whales on them at one time in the 80s.
sentences.zh: 他确实说，他觉得现实中的安迪·伯纳德在80年代可能也穿过那种印着鲸鱼图案的学院风腰带。

sentences.en: But besides that, nothing else.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，就没什么相似之处了。

sentences.en: He said the real Andy would never punch his fist through a wall.
sentences.zh: 他说现实中的安迪绝不会一拳打穿墙壁。

sentences.en: However, Greg said the real life Jim Halpert is very sociable, athletic, and romantic.
sentences.zh: 不过，格雷格说现实生活中的吉姆·哈珀特非常善于社交、热爱运动且浪漫。

sentences.en: Oh.
Greg said he was at his wedding, and his marriage was beautiful, and his wife is completely Pam-worthy.
sentences.zh: 格雷格说他参加过他的婚礼，那场婚礼很美，而且他的妻子完全配得上“帕姆”这个名字。

sentences.en: He has many of the qualities that he wanted the character of Jim to have as well.
sentences.zh: 他身上具备许多格雷格希望吉姆这个角色也拥有的品质。

sentences.en: Greg said when he met John Krasinski, he reminded him of the real life Jim Halpert.
sentences.zh: 格雷格说，当他见到约翰·卡拉辛斯基时，他想起了现实生活中的吉姆·哈珀特。

sentences.en: Greg said they're both incredibly admirable men.
sentences.zh: 格雷格说他们都是非常令人钦佩的人。

sentences.en: Greg said that in real life, Andy Bernard is a renowned economist who studies globalization
sentences.zh: 格雷格说，在现实生活中，安迪·伯纳德是一位著名的经济学家，专门研究全球化，

sentences.en: and was named by Reuters as one of the world's most influential scientific minds.
sentences.zh: 并被路透社评为世界上最具影响力的科学头脑之一。

sentences.en: Oh, my goodness.
The real life Jim Halpert works in the White House as general counsel to the national cyber director
sentences.zh: 现实生活中的吉姆·哈珀特在白宫担任国家网络总监的法律总顾问，

sentences.en: trying to write laws to protect people's security and privacy on the internet.
sentences.zh: 致力于制定法律以保护人们在互联网上的安全和隐私。

sentences.en: Okay, Greg's friends are really smart.
sentences.zh: 好吧，格雷格的朋友们真的很聪明。

sentences.en: He said this is why I asked them both if it was okay to share a recent photo of the three of us.
sentences.zh: 他说这就是为什么我问他们俩是否介意分享一张我们三个人的近照。

sentences.en: Oh.
And Greg said we can put it in the Office Ladies pod Instagram stories.
sentences.zh: 格雷格说我们可以把它发到《办公室女士》播客的Instagram快拍里。

sentences.en: Oh, great.
Yes, and it's the cutest picture.
sentences.zh: 没错，而且那张照片可爱极了。

sentences.en: And I'm just imagining these three guys all the way back in first grade.
sentences.zh: 我脑海里浮现出他们三个从小学一年级开始的样子。

sentences.en: Yeah.
There's probably not a photo of that because we just didn't have cameras like we do now, but I love this friendship.
sentences.zh: 可能没有那时的照片，因为我们当时没有现在这样的相机，但我很喜欢这份友谊。

sentences.en: What a lifelong friendship.
Yeah.
Oh, I love that.
Thank you, Greg.
Thank you, Greg, and thank you, Curtis.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，格雷格，也谢谢你，柯蒂斯。

sentences.en: Yes, and for all of you Greg Daniels fans out there, you know, season three of Upload is now streaming on Amazon Prime Video.
sentences.zh: 没错，各位格雷格·丹尼尔斯的粉丝们，你们知道，《上传》第三季现在已经在亚马逊 Prime Video 上线了。

sentences.en: The trailer is awesome.
We have to put that in our stories, Angela.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，我们得把它发到我们的快拍里。

sentences.en: And by the way, if you have not watched Upload, it is so good.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，如果你还没看过《上传》，它真的非常好看。

sentences.en: It has like 93% on Rotten Tomatoes.
sentences.zh: 它在烂番茄上有 93% 的新鲜度。

sentences.en: You should definitely check it out.
Well, that's all I have for Fast Facts, lady.
sentences.zh: 好了，这就是我准备的快讯，女士。

sentences.en: Should we get into our last breakdown of an episode from season eight?
sentences.zh: 我们要开始解析第八季的最后一集了吗？

sentences.en: Let's do it because we have a little bit of old tech that was new tech at the time.
sentences.zh: 开始吧，因为里面有一些当时算新技术，现在看来是旧科技的东西。

sentences.en: Oh.
Well, we'll take a break and discuss.
sentences.zh: 那我们休息一下，回来再讨论。

sentences.en: We are back and Oscar is talking directly to a camera on his computer.
sentences.zh: 我们回来了，奥斯卡正在对着他电脑上的摄像头说话。

sentences.en: He's doing like one of those.
Like a webcam.
A webcam, like, you know, like one of those confessionals that folks do on YouTube now.
sentences.zh: 网络摄像头，你知道，就像现在人们在 YouTube 上做的那些访谈视频一样。

sentences.en: You guys, people were not doing this yet.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，当时人们还没开始这么做呢。

sentences.en: This was the very beginning.
sentences.zh: 这还处于非常早期的阶段。

sentences.en: So this whole scene and the way the camera was set up and how Oscar's talking directly to the internet, as I call it.
sentences.zh: 所以整个这一幕，以及摄像头的设置方式，还有奥斯卡直接对着互联网——我称之为互联网——说话的方式。

sentences.en: Yes.
That wasn't really happening.
And it wasn't featured very much on television.
sentences.zh: 而且电视节目里也很少出现这种形式。

sentences.en: So this was a little bit of like, you know, new technology.
sentences.zh: 所以这算是一种比较新的技术。

sentences.en: And of course, now we look at it and we're like, oh my gosh.
sentences.zh: 当然，现在我们回看这一幕会觉得，天哪。

sentences.en: Yeah, people do it all the time.
sentences.zh: 是啊，人们现在无时无刻不在做这个。

sentences.en: All the time.
Well, I asked Steve Burgess, how did we get this shot?
sentences.zh: 我问了史蒂夫·伯吉斯，我们是怎么拍到这个镜头的？

sentences.en: And he said, Matt Soan just set up one of the cameras on Oscar's desk, moved the computer out of the way, and set the camera there with this sort of special lens.
sentences.zh: 他说马特·索恩只是把其中一台摄像机架在奥斯卡的桌子上，把电脑移开，然后用那种特殊的镜头对准那里。

sentences.en: And then everybody just walked over and talked into it as if it was a webcam.
sentences.zh: 然后每个人走过来对着它说话，就像对着网络摄像头一样。

sentences.en: It's very funny.
You know, Dwight and Phyllis are kind of lurking behind.
sentences.zh: 你知道，德怀特和菲利斯在后面鬼鬼祟祟的。

sentences.en: Kelly comes in and touches up her makeup.
Robert then comes in and just starts talking straight to camera, takes over, headbutts Kevin, and then it all falls apart.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特随后进来，直接对着镜头说话，抢了镜头，还用头撞了凯文，然后一切就乱套了。

sentences.en: So Oscar ultimately tells the youth, you know what, it may not get much better, but it does get a little better.
sentences.zh: 所以奥斯卡最后告诉年轻人，你知道吗，情况可能不会好转太多，但确实会变好一点点。

sentences.en: Well, this episode opens with a Dwight talking head.
sentences.zh: 这一集是以德怀特的单人访谈开场的。

sentences.en: And he's explaining that he wanted to give the tenants of the building something nice.
sentences.zh: 他解释说他想给大楼的租户们提供一些好的服务。

sentences.en: So he has set up a family portrait studio in the break room.
sentences.zh: 所以他在休息室里搭建了一个全家福摄影棚。

sentences.en: And during this talking head, we're seeing groups of people getting their picture taken.
sentences.zh: 在这次访谈过程中，我们看到一群群人正在拍照。

sentences.en: Yes.
I will say for this montage, everyone that's getting their picture taken, there was written dialogue.
sentences.zh: 我得说，对于这段蒙太奇，每一个拍照的人其实都有写好的台词。

sentences.en: There was?
Yes, that wasn't used.
Please tell me more.
Well, Toby and his daughter are doing a dance, and she's like saying, jazz hands, dad, and he can't quite get it.
sentences.zh: 托比和他的女儿在跳舞，女儿对他说，爸爸，爵士手势，但他总是做不到位。

sentences.en: Stanley and his daughter just have a sweet moment, you know.
sentences.zh: 斯坦利和他的女儿则有一个温馨的瞬间，你知道的。

sentences.en: And then Creed and his parents, he's like, look, I'm in a parent's sandwich.
sentences.zh: 还有克里德和他的父母，他说，看，我夹在父母中间了。

sentences.en: You know, Creed is just being cuckoo pants.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，克里德就是那么疯疯癫癫的。

sentences.en: And then Meredith and her son just continue to yell at each other.
sentences.zh: 然后梅雷迪思和她儿子继续互相大吼大叫。

sentences.en: I see.
Yeah.
So there was just extra beats of all of it.
sentences.zh: 所以这些片段都多拍了一些。

sentences.en: Well, if you're wondering who played all the family members, Toby's daughter was played by Delaney Ruth Farrell.
sentences.zh: 如果你好奇这些家庭成员都是谁演的，托比的女儿是由德莱尼·露丝·法瑞尔饰演的。

sentences.en: She was the daughter of our set dresser.
sentences.zh: 她是我们的布景师的女儿。

sentences.en: Stanley's daughter was played by Sarah Rebecca.
sentences.zh: 斯坦利的女儿由莎拉·丽贝卡饰演。

sentences.en: Creed's parents were played by Ed Ford Jr.
sentences.zh: 克里德的父母由小埃德·福特饰演。

sentences.en: and Jackie Beno.
And Meredith's son was played again by Spencer Daniels.
sentences.zh: 梅雷迪思的儿子依然由斯宾塞·丹尼尔斯饰演。

sentences.en: Shout out to our actual NBC set photographer and Kate Flannery's longtime fella, Chris Hastings, for working the Dwight's Family Portrait Studio.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢我们真正的NBC片场摄影师，也是凯特·弗兰纳里的长期伴侣克里斯·黑斯廷斯，他在德怀特的家庭肖像摄影室里帮忙。

sentences.en: You'll see him in the corner.
He's sitting at the desk, kind of logging all the pictures onto the computer.
sentences.zh: 他坐在桌子旁，负责把照片录入电脑。

sentences.en: I saw him.
I also want to share with you guys in the shooting draft, there would have been an establishing shot of the flyer for this free family portrait studio.
sentences.zh: 我还想和大家分享一下，在拍摄剧本中，原本有一个关于这个免费家庭肖像摄影室传单的定场镜头。

sentences.en: And here's what it said.
Oh, boy.
In all caps on the flyer, it says, free family portrait studio, all professional, exclamation point, May 9th, noon to 5 p.m.
sentences.zh: 传单上用大写字母写着：免费家庭肖像摄影室，全专业水准，感叹号，5月9日，中午12点到下午5点。

sentences.en: in Dunder Mifflin break room, courtesy of building manager Dwight K.
sentences.zh: 地点在邓德·米夫林休息室，由大楼经理德怀特·K·施鲁特提供。

sentences.en: Schrute.
All professional, please, guys.
Keep it professional.
And I have another tidbit to add about this scene.
sentences.zh: 关于这场戏，我还有个小花絮要补充。

sentences.en: You thought I was done.
I've got one, too.
It's the scene that keeps on giving.
sentences.zh: 这真是一场惊喜不断的戏。

sentences.en: Okay.
Here's mine.
In the shooting draft, the person who was in the very front of the line who would have been first up to get their picture taken was, any guesses?
sentences.zh: 在拍摄剧本里，排在队伍最前面、第一个去拍照的人是谁，猜猜看？

sentences.en: Oh, this is a good question.
Kevin?
No.
It was Brandon.
And this might explain a little bit of that photo at the end.
sentences.zh: 这或许能解释最后那张照片的一些细节。

sentences.en: Here's how it read, and it's also in deleted scenes.
sentences.zh: 剧本是这样写的，这段内容也在删减片段里。

sentences.en: Interior break room.
Brandon and Val are at the front of the line.
sentences.zh: 布兰登和瓦尔排在队伍最前面。

sentences.en: Photographer, next up.
Brandon checks himself in a compact mirror and steps up.
sentences.zh: 布兰登对着粉饼盒里的镜子整理了一下，走上前去。

sentences.en: Val follows.
Brandon waves her off and says, baby, I need some singles, okay?
sentences.zh: 布兰登挥手让她走开，说：宝贝，我需要些零钱，好吗？

sentences.en: She says, what?
And he goes, I need some singles.
And he shoes her away.
And then he turns to the photographer and he says, can we clear some of this kid's stuff out of here?
sentences.zh: 接着他转向摄影师说，能不能把这孩子的东西清理一下？

sentences.en: This is a promotional shot for my restaurant, and I am selling three things.
sentences.zh: 这是我餐厅的宣传照，我主要卖三样东西。
